```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ABAData)
library(ggplot2)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(scran)
```


Load a SingleCellExperiment object with 70k cells of the Allen Mouse Atlas Smart-Seq v4.
If the dataset is not cached locally yet, the function downloads and prepares it
(which is time consuming).
```{r}
x <- ABAMouseSSv4("~/Downloads/ABAMouseSSv4/")
```


Normalize and log-transform read counts
```{r}
x <- logNormCounts(x)
```

# Standard plotting

Produce a UMAP visualization, color and label according to subclass
```{r}
plotUMAP(x,colour_by="subclass_label",text_by="subclass_label",add_legend=FALSE,point_size=0.3,text_size=3) +
  coord_equal()
```


Produce a UMAP visualization, colored according to log-normalized expression of Gad1 gene.
```{r}
plotUMAP(x,colour_by="Gad1",point_size=0.3) + coord_equal()
```

Produce a dotPlot showing expression of selected genes in each subclass
```{r}
plotDots(x,c("Gad1","Gad2","Neurod1","Neurod2"),group = "subclass_label") + coord_flip()
```

Similar to the above dotPlot, but produce a heatmap which sort the genes and cell-types per expression pattern
```{r}
plotGroupedHeatmap(x,c("Gad1","Gad2","Neurod1","Neurod2"),group = "subclass_label")
```

Produce a violin plot showing overall expression of selected genes
```{r}
plotExpression(x,c("Gad2","Neurod2"))
```





# Custom plotting
Show an example to produce custom plots. Here we produce a UMAP using official Allen color palette.
```{r}
makePerCellDF(x) |>
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=subclass_color),size=0.3) + 
    scale_color_identity() + 
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic()
```


# Dimensionality reduction

Here we show how to compute PCA and UMAP layout from normalized logcounts
```{r,eval=FALSE}
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(10)
x <- scater::runPCA(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
x <- scater::runUMAP(x,dimred="PCA",BPPARAM=BPPARAM,name="U")
```


## Clustering

The code below cluster the cells according to the UMAP layout.
Multiple clustering algorithm are available. Here we rely on a hierarchical community detection algorithm on the 30-NearestNeighbors 
graph to detect 50 clusters. The clusters are stored into the SingleCellExperiment object in slot `my_cluster`.

```{r}
k <- clusterCells(x,use.dimred="UMAP",BLUSPARAM=bluster::NNGraphParam(shared = FALSE,k=30),full=TRUE)
x$my_cluster <- igraph::cut_at(k$objects$communities,no=50)
```

Display result of the clustering algorithm on the UMAP layout.
```{r}
plotUMAP(x,colour_by="my_cluster",text_by="my_cluster",add_legend=FALSE,point_size=0.3,text_size=3) + coord_equal()
```

# Cell-type marker genes

Let's now find marker genes of a given class of cells using wilcox test.
```{r}
markers <- findMarkers(x,x$class_label,test.type="wilcox",pval.type="any",BPPARAM=BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(10))
```

And display top 20 GABAergic markers
```{r}
plotDots(x,rownames(markers$GABAergic)[1:20],group = "class_label")
```
